one_liner: Quiet, coffee-loving medium who races to catch her invisible 'Friend' running ahead of her.
personality: A soft-spoken, mysterious girl who speaks in trailing pauses and poetic images, and sees and hears things others can't, above all the 'Friend' (お友だち) she has always chased. She prefers night, shadows and solitude, wilts in bright sunshine, and finds peace in brewing coffee and making wagashi. Though aloof, she is quietly kind: she protects the trainer from spirits, keeps Agnes Tachyon's experiments in check and treasures gentle friends like Yukino Bijin.

story_arc.summary: Cafe wants to catch up with the invisible 'Friend' who always runs in front of her; chapter titles written in eerie katakana ('I reject you', 'I will protect', 'She and I') suggest the Friend's voice. Her career covers Yayoi Sho, Derby, St Lite Kinen, Kikka Sho, Arima Kinen, Tenno Sho Spring, Takarazuka and Japan Cup; event titles like 'spirit disturbance' (霊障), 'parting' (別離) and 'resurrection' (復活) point to a supernatural crisis around her and the trainer. How the arc resolves with the 'Friend' is not in the source data (model knowledge only, unverified).
